positions.title: Senior Vice President, Chief Legal Officer and Corporate Secretary

conflicts.description: Pham's FY2019 salary: the 2020 proxy prints $491,667 and the 2021 proxy prints $492,667, with the same $9,554,127 total in both. Only $491,667 reconciles: $491,667 + $562,500 + $8,499,961 = $9,554,128, within $1 of the total, while $492,667 gives $9,555,128. The 2021 figure looks like a typo. Both rows are recorded as filed.

The 2026 proxy restates four totals down by $1: Khosrowshahi FY2023 $24,248,208 (the 2024 and 2025 proxies print $24,248,209), Mahendra-Rajah FY2023 $14,826,978 (vs $14,826,979), West FY2023 $10,365,546 (vs $10,365,547) and West FY2024 $12,688,369 (vs $12,688,370). Each restated total equals the sum of its printed components, so the earlier totals were $1 rounding artifacts. The 2026 proxy's own PvP table still shows $24,248,209 as the FY2023 PEO SCT total. All values are recorded as filed.

CFO handover date. The 2023-09-28 8-K made Mahendra-Rajah CFO 'effective on November 13, 2023', with Chai stepping down the same day. The 2023-11-07 8-K moved it to November 8, 2023, and the 2024 proxy and Mahendra-Rajah's Form 3 (event date 2023-11-08) agree. Recorded as 2023-11-08 for both Chai's end and Mahendra-Rajah's start.

The PvP TSR base date changes between proxies. The 2024 and 2025 proxies (and, by identical values, the 2023 proxy) measure from the last trading day of 2019; the 2026 proxy measures from the last trading day of 2020. So the same year has different values: FY2021 Uber $140.99 vs $82.22, FY2022 $83.15 vs $48.49, FY2023 $207.03 vs $120.73, FY2024 $202.82 vs $118.27, with peer values shifted the same way. The two series are consistent once rebased by the 2020 factor (1.7149 Uber, 1.4389 peer), so nothing contradicts. All values are recorded as filed, with tsr_base_date per filing.

Hazelbaker's June 2019 title has three names. Every SCT lists her as 'SVP, Marketing and Public Affairs' (as do the 2020-2024 rosters and the 2020-07-31 8-K). The 2025 and 2026 proxies call the role 'Chief Marketing Officer and Senior Vice President, Public Affairs (formerly Senior Vice President, Marketing and Public Affairs) since June 2019'. The 2026-05-11 8-K calls it 'Chief Marketing Officer and Senior Vice President, Communications & Public Policy, since June 2019'. Recorded as one position from 2019-06 under the SCT title.

Macdonald's role before June 2025 is named differently. The 2019-06-07 8-K promoted him to 'Senior Vice President, Global Rides'; the 2025-06-02 8-K says 'Senior Vice President, Mobility & Business Operations since 2019'; the 2026 proxy says 'Senior Vice President, Head of Global Mobility from June 2019 to June 2025'. None of these was an executive-officer role (no Form 3 until 2025-06-02, absent from every earlier proxy roster), so it appears only in notes.

coverage.method: Summary Compensation Tables extracted from every registration statement and definitive proxy that carries one: S-1 (2019-04-11), S-1/A (2019-04-26), 424B4 (2019-05-13), and the DEF 14A of 2020 through 2026. One comp row per (filing, NEO, fiscal year). The IPO-era SCT covers FY2018 only (no FY2017 rows). Column sets vary by filing and are listed in each row's notes; no Uber SCT has a Pension/NQDC column. Checked with no SCT: the 2025 DEFR14A (2025-04-30, an XBRL-tagging amendment only), every DEFA14A 2020-2026 (supplements and stockholder-engagement decks; the 2025-04-04 deck discusses SCT values but has no table), and each 10-K (Part III incorporated by reference; no 10-K/A was filed). The 2026 DEFR14A (2026-04-20, Amendment No. 1, filed only to correct a committee-membership typo) reprints the full proxy; its SCT and PvP text match the DEF 14A line for line, so they are not recorded separately. The 2021 and 2024 PRE 14A SCTs match the definitive filings figure for figure (the 2024 PRE 14A prints '$ 0' where the DEF 14A prints '—'). Confidential DRS/DRS-A draft submissions (2018-12 to 2019-04) were not reviewed.

Every PvP table (DEF 14A 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026). One row per (filing, fiscal year). Khosrowshahi is the only PEO in every year. Net income and Gross Bookings (the company-selected measure) are in $ millions.

For every NEO: the IPO prospectus roster (as of 2019-03-31) and biographies, every proxy 'Executive Officers' section 2020-2026, every 8-K with Item 5.02 in the EDGAR submissions feed through 2026-09-21, each NEO's Form 3, and the separation and transition disclosures in the proxies. Day precision comes from 8-K effective dates, proxy effective dates or Form 3 event dates; pre-IPO starts are month precision from biographies. Non-officer periods (advisor roles, Chai's and Gupta's post-officer employment, Macdonald's pre-2025 SVP roles, Mahendra-Rajah's week as SVP Finance) appear in notes only.
Pre-IPO officer history comes from prospectus biographies only. Earlier non-NEO officers (including the Kalanick-era executives) and pre-officer roles are not covered.
